metadata.name: peoplepad_amm
metadata.description: PEOPLE'S PAD constant-product AMM: graduated coins trade here (clean-room, PumpSwap-shaped)

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy an exact amount of base tokens, paying at most `max_quote_amount_in` (fees included).

instructions.name: collect_coin_creator_fee
docs: The coin creator sweeps everything in their vault for `quote_mint` into their own ATA.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Owner of the initial liquidity. May be a PDA of another program (the curve) signing via CPI.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the new accounts (the curve passes the migrating user here).

accounts.name: locked_lp_token_account
docs: Holds MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY LP forever (owned by the pool PDA, which never signs a burn/transfer of it).

accounts.name: coin_creator_vault_ata
docs: Created here so buy/sell never need to init accounts.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the LP mint (classic SPL Token).

instructions.name: disable
docs: Kill switch. Bits: 1 create_pool, 2 deposit, 4 withdraw, 8 buy, 16 sell.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell an exact amount of base tokens, receiving at least `min_quote_amount_out` (after fees).

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero
